events.title: Rogue Berry Afternoon Tea
events.description: Indulge in an exquisite afternoon tea experience featuring locally sourced strawberries from the Royal Project in northern Thailand. This seasonal offering showcases the region's winter bounty. Available from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
events.venue: 1897 Lounge, Siam Kempinski Hotel Bangkok, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: In Reverent Remembrance of the Royal Grace of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother Art Exhibition
events.description: An invaluable art exhibition featuring works by two National Artists. The exhibition is presented in reverent remembrance of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.
events.venue: Art Jewel, 5th Floor, Siam Paragon, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: BUGTOPIA at Siam Paragon
events.description: Discover the secrets of tiny insects and learn about their journey of growth, from tiny eggs to soaring. This engaging and educational event explores the fascinating kingdom of insects.
events.venue: Siam Paragon, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: Three Cities of Art Exhibition
events.description: A transformative exhibition showcasing Dvaravati aesthetics reinterpreted in the context of modern art. It offers a glimpse into community-based art and art practices. Daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
events.venue: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC), Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: The Mango Art Festival
events.description: Thailand's vibrant contemporary art festival returns, spotlighting Thai and international artists across five colorful days. Explore six main zones with exhibitions, talks, and performances. Free admission.
events.venue: River City Bangkok, Charoenkrung, Bangkok

events.title: Solomonari Festival 2026 Teaser Party Bangkok
events.description: A teaser party for the upcoming Solomonari Festival 2026, offering a night of music and vibrant atmosphere. From 7:00 PM till 1:00 AM.
events.venue: Bangkok Island, Rama III, Yan Nawa, Bangkok

events.title: ICONSIAM PETs CARE
events.description: A community event inviting pet owners to receive free microchipping and rabies vaccinations for their beloved animals. This initiative focuses on promoting pet welfare and responsible ownership.
events.venue: ICONSIAM, Khlong San, Bangkok

events.title: Luke Alessi at Æther BKK
events.description: Enjoy a night of music with a performance by DJ Luke Alessi.
events.venue: Æther BKK, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok

events.title: RWS Rajadamnern World Series
events.description: A night of world-class Muay Thai featuring championship-level fights, immersive lighting, state-of-the-art sound, and a 360° dome projection showcasing Muay Thai history. Gates open at 6:00 PM, with the first bell at 7:00 PM. The event concludes around 10:00 PM.
events.venue: Rajadamnern Stadium, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok

events.title: HER-story Maker: Celebrating International Women's Day 2026
events.description: This event showcases the success stories of visionary women who leverage innovation to propel their businesses. Activities include a keynote address on the role of women leaders, a panel discussion on conscious consumption, and exclusive discounts at participating restaurants. Happening from 1:00 PM to 5:30 PM. Free.
events.venue: SCBX NEXT STAGE @ NEXT TECH, 4th Floor, Siam Paragon, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: Bangkok International Music Festival 2026
events.description: A festival offering a great opportunity to perform and showcase musical talents. Meet and enjoy performances from artists playing a variety of instruments on a professional stage. Receive a certificate of participation.
events.venue: Auditorium room, 5th floor, Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC), Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: Kiatpetch Muay Thai Rajadamnern
events.description: An unforgettable evening of authentic Thai boxing with world-class fighters in traditional championship battles. The event showcases the true art of eight limbs with 8 electrifying bouts. From 6:00 PM to 8:10 PM.
events.venue: Rajadamnern Stadium, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok

events.title: ตลาดโสดซอย 5 (Single Market Soi 5)
events.description: A unique market event at Banthat Thong Walking Street where singles can mingle and explore various stalls. Expect a lively atmosphere with opportunities for socializing and shopping. Free entry.
events.venue: Banthat Thong Walking Street, Chula Soi 5, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: FIBA 3x3 Champions Cup 2026
events.description: Elite national 3x3 basketball teams from around the world collide in Bangkok, competing for qualification to the FIBA 3x3 World Cup 2027. This high-level international showdown celebrates performance and competitiveness. Event entrance is free of charge.
events.venue: CentralWorld Square, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: ONE Fight Night 41: Rodrigues vs. Phetjeeja
events.description: The world’s largest martial arts organization storms into Bangkok for ONE Fight Night 41, featuring two World Title fights. Allycia Hellen Rodrigues defends her ONE Women’s Atomweight Muay Thai World Championship against Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom. Global superstars will clash in Muay Thai and submission grappling. From 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM.
events.venue: Lumpinee Stadium, Bang Khen, Bangkok

events.title: Music in the Park (Lumpini)
events.description: A free concert in Lumpini Park featuring invited artists KOH Mr.Saxman, Peach 38 years ago, and Fern Pause. A relaxing afternoon of live music in a beautiful setting. Starts at 5:30 PM.
events.venue: Sala Bhirmbhakdi, Lumpini Park, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: HARD EDGE: Dark&Industrial Hard Techno
events.description: A night dedicated to dark and industrial hard techno music. Immerse yourself in the intense beats and atmosphere.
events.venue: Culture Cafe, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok

events.title: 2026 Thailand Sport Climbing Championships
events.description: A national championship event showcasing top sport climbing talent over three days. Competitions include speed, bouldering, and lead climbing disciplines. From 7:30 AM to 8:00 PM daily.
events.venue: Bangkok Sport Climbing Center, Bang Kapi, Bangkok

events.title: The 9th White Elephant Award Exhibition “The Land of Smiles”
events.description: This exhibition celebrates Thailand through realistic and figurative art pieces, including paintings, sculptures, prints, and mixed media. Free entry.
events.venue: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC), Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: 44th Thailand Tourism Festival
events.description: Discover the wonders of Thailand’s five regions all in one place. The festival features local delicacies, cultural performances, creative workshops, and exclusive travel deals. Held from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily.
events.venue: Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), Khlong Toei, Bangkok

events.title: Art Battle Bangkok
events.description: Watch exceptional artists transform blank canvases into stunning masterpieces in a series of timed rounds, testing creativity and skill. The audience plays a crucial role, voting to decide which artist advances and is crowned champion. The event promises an electric and inspiring atmosphere. From 7:00 PM.
events.venue: The Fig Lobby Bangkok, Khlong Toei, Bangkok

events.title: CHILLI FEST 2026
events.description: A fiery festival bringing together top chefs and restaurants from across Bangkok and Thailand, serving exclusive chilli-inspired dishes. Features modern Punjabi street food, offbeat Thai-Chinese dining, and modern Korean cuisine with bold, spicy flavors. Buy tickets.
events.venue: Urban Oasis, Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

events.title: Over the Rainbow Rooftop T-Dance SS2
events.description: A vibrant rooftop T-dance party with DJs and music, offering a lively atmosphere high above the city. Starts at 5:00 PM.
events.venue: Mimi's Bangkok, dusitD2 Samyan, Bang Rak, Bangkok

events.title: Music in the Park (Lumpini)
events.description: A free concert at Lumpini Park as part of the Bangkok Music Festival and 100 Years of Lumpini Park celebration. Featuring performances by Rose Sirintip and Tee Jetset'er. Starts at 6:00 PM.
events.venue: Lumpini Park, Pathum Wan, Bangkok
